description: Interview session lifecycle. Extends the BLUEPRINT section 4 diagram (v1) with the pause, resume, withdrawal and expiry transitions recorded in ADR-012. The control plane is the only component that executes transitions.

actors.candidate: Authenticated candidate acting on their own session through the public API.
actors.tier1_agent: Tier-1 voice agent holding a valid session lease. Deterministic agent code issues these calls; the language model can only reach request R01.
actors.system: Control-plane internal logic: the deterministic flow engine, signed LiveKit webhooks, lease and deadline sweepers.
actors.tier2_pipeline: Tier-2 evaluation pipeline acting only through the control-plane API (wired in Phase 2).

states.name: CREATED
states.description: Interview created by staff; invitation issued, not yet exchanged.

states.name: CONSENT_PENDING
states.description: Candidate authenticated via invitation; notice shown, decisions pending.

states.name: READY
states.description: Required purposes accepted; candidate may start.

states.name: CALIBRATION
states.description: Greeting and audio/text check. Candidate input received here is never evidence.

states.name: QUESTION_ACTIVE
states.description: Exactly one plan item is active and being asked or awaiting an answer.

states.name: CANDIDATE_SPEAKING
states.description: At least one candidate segment has been attributed to the open activation (answer in progress).

states.name: ANSWER_PROCESSING
states.description: Answer finalized; the flow engine selects the next step in the same transaction.

states.name: FOLLOW_UP
states.description: An unconditional approved follow-up is selected; activated in the same transaction.

states.name: PAUSED
states.description: Interview paused; paused_from is recorded and audio intake is stopped.

states.name: INTERVIEW_COMPLETED
states.description: All plan items answered; closing remarks only.

states.name: CANCELLED
states.description: Consent declined, candidate withdrew, or the pause expired. No completion event is emitted.

guards.invitation_valid: Invitation token hash matches and is unexpired, and the exchange was initiated by a user action. The first exchange performs T01; later exchanges only replace the candidate session.
guards.required_purposes_decided: Every purpose in the pinned notice version has an explicit decision and all required purposes are granted.
guards.notice_version_pinned: The decision references the exact notice version that was displayed.
guards.any_required_purpose_declined: At least one required purpose was explicitly declined.
guards.retention_policy_configured: Explicit retention durations are configured for every data category the session will create.
guards.calibration_confirmed: Agent: at least one candidate segment was received during calibration (never evidence). Candidate: explicit Begin action.
guards.candidate_segment_in_open_activation: A candidate segment whose start_ms falls inside the open activation's answer window was persisted.
guards.completion_request_resolved: A matching completion request (R01) exists for the open activation and either the agent confirmed the transcript flush manifest or the request deadline elapsed (then missing_segments=true).
guards.approved_follow_up_pending: The pinned plan contains an unconditional follow-up for the finalized item that has not been activated.
guards.next_plan_item_exists: No unconditional follow-up is pending for the finalized item and the pinned plan contains a further top-level item.
guards.plan_exhausted: No further plan item or follow-up exists.
guards.paused_from_question: paused_from is QUESTION_ACTIVE or CANDIDATE_SPEAKING; resume opens a new activation of the same plan item.
guards.pause_timeout_elapsed: The configured pause timeout (product policy) has elapsed since the pause began.

requests.name: answer_completion_requested
requests.description: Requests finalization of the open activation's answer. Must carry activation_id and state_version. Resolution requires the agent's transcript flush manifest or the request deadline. This is the only operation the Tier-1 language model can trigger (tool mark_answer_complete).

invariants.statement: A session has at most one open question activation.
Final evaluation is idempotent per answer and rubric version (enforced in Phase 2).
No transition is triggered by barge-in, VAD edges or provider interruption events.
Reconnect or retry cannot create duplicate answers: one answer per (session, plan item, answer_version).
Candidate input content cannot trigger privileged transitions: no guard depends on transcript content, and the language model can only reach R01.
tier2_pipeline and reviewer actors have no transition out of a pre_interview or live state.
Every transition, including each step of a chain, is authorized, validated, timestamped and recorded as its own session event with the causing actor.
Every transition available to tier1_agent is also available to the candidate (directly or through a candidate request), except calibration_complete which the candidate can also perform.
Transient states (ANSWER_PROCESSING, FOLLOW_UP) are entered and left inside one transaction and are never observed at rest.
Sessions that end CANCELLED emit no interview.completed event.
